messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy check failed for release 2026-03-20-rc4. Block reason: feature flag sentinel key "inference.cache.enable_v2" present in staging configmap, missing in prod. Blocking promotion of image redwood/inference:2026-03-20-rc4. Check details: https://deploybot.internal/ci/2951239876

olivia: saw it. staging team added the sentinel via a small helm patch last night. prod wasn't updated. who's owner for prod config? @raj

raj: that's me — I changed flag naming in the values schema yesterday. didn't realize RC4 depended on the new sentinel. sorry. do we backfill prod or rollback the image?

noah: prefer backfill if it's a quick surface change. it's only a configmap key, secrets untouched. but note we are in the 16:00 change window and infra needs to watch it.

amanda: ops here — change window is fine for a hot backfill + canary, but we need to pin the stable image for non-canary clusters to avoid mixed behavior. ops will monitor.

olivia: propose plan: 1) backfill prod configmap with the sentinel key (fast) 2) promote RC4 to canary after config parity and watch for 15m-30m 3) if issues, rollback to pinned stable image. who can run the backfill?

raj: I can. quick command (or do via helm upgrade):
```
# dry-run example
kubectl -n redwood get configmap inference-config -o yaml | sed '/data:/a \  inference.cache.enable_v2: "true"' | kubectl apply -f - --dry-run=client
```
I'll do a dry-run and paste the output here before applying.

noah: also please add a short release note: "hotfix: backfill missing prod flag to match staging; canary promotion" and update CHANGELOG + internal release notes for on-call.

olivia: add a follow-up action: enhance deploybot preflight to diff sentinel/feature flag keys across envs so this doesn't block future rollouts.

raj: running dry-run now... output: "configmap/inference-config configured (dry-run)". scheduling the backfill at 16:05 UTC and will apply then. pinning non-canary clusters to redwood/inference:2026-03-19-stable as Amanda suggested.

deploy-bot: Note: I'll allow promotion to canary once prod config matches staging. Recommend monitoring latency, error-rate, and model-cache miss rate for 30m after canary start.

amanda: ack. ops will watch dashboards and traces. threshold: if error rate > 0.5% or P95 latency increases by >20% revert to redwood/inference:2026-03-19-stable. @raj update thread when backfill is applied.

raj: done at 2951239920 — applied configmap in prod, canary started. health checks green at +4m. removing hold and proceeding with staged rollout per plan.
